item.title: Critical wildfire danger in Texas panhandle today, officials warn
item.description: The Texas A&M Forest Service is warning residents to stay alert today due to critical wildfire conditions, with high winds, low humidity, and dry vegetation increasing the potential for fast-moving and hard-to-control fires.

item.title: Apartment fire in Southwest Houston under investigation
item.description: The Houston Fire Department responded to an apartment fire in west Houston early Friday morning, with no official word on injuries or the cause of the fire.

item.title: Texas man was fatally shot by a federal immigration agent last year during a stop, new records show
item.description: A U.S. citizen was shot and killed by a federal immigration officer during a late-night traffic stop nearly a year ago in a Texas beach town crowded with young people celebrating spring break.

item.title: Trump announces new tariffs, investigations after Supreme Court ruling
item.description: President Trump said Friday he would raise preexisting tariffs and begin the process of imposing new ones after the Supreme Court struck down many of his import taxes on foreign trading partners.

item.title: 3 hurt in drive-by shooting in northwest Harris County, constable says
item.description: Three people were shot near a park in northwest Harris County after an alleged drug deal led to gun shots.

item.title: Texas' most populous counties see higher numbers of early voters
item.description: In the first few days since early voting started, the most populous counties in Texas are seeing a higher turnout than the past two primaries.

item.title: 33 arrested, $417,752 seized in Hitchcock illegal gambling raid, sheriff says
item.description: Thirty-three people, including the mayor of Hitchcock, Texas, were arrested and $417,752 seized in a large illegal gambling raid, authorities said.

item.title: Part of I-10 Katy Freeway to be closed this weekend
item.description: The I-10 closure will take place for all eastbound lanes from Shepherd Drive/Durham Drive to Houston Avenue.

item.title: Body of man found in parking lot in north Harris County, HCSO says
item.description: The man was found with a possible gunshot wound, Harris County Sheriff Ed Gonzalez said.

item.title: Deconstruction starts at Garden Oaks Theater as preservation group urges action
item.description: Deconstruction is underway at the historic Garden Oaks Theater in Houston. The 1947 landmark was sold in October, and preservation group Arthouse Houston continues efforts to save it.
